decisions.reason: As a more peripheral consumer product with ongoing marketing and channel costs, and only limited evidence of traction beyond 2019, it is the weakest option relative to the firm's core industrial technology portfolio.
Because it is a modular extension of the established waste-to-energy business, the firm can keep this option open at relatively low cost while market demand remains uncertain.
Its dedicated product presence and clear fit with the firm's core decentralized energy and waste-conversion capabilities suggest enough potential to justify continued market presence.
Although the economics are still uncertain, its close adjacency to the firm's core recycling and fuel technologies makes it a worthwhile option to retain for now.
